name: Evolve CIMA road
why_interesting: Repeatedly featured in ChineseCarbon top posts; a distinct road frameset, not the existing CIMA GR.

facts.frame_weight_basis: Manufacturer: size M, unpainted frame only
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Manufacturer lists 700C tires from 24C to 32C; verify measured tire/rim fit
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, ML, L, XL
facts.frame: Electronic shifting only; Shimano/SRAM electronic and Campagnolo WRL listed, EPS excluded
facts.included_package: Frame, fork and seatpost; Kreuza Apex integrated handlebar is an optional bundle addition. Confirm remaining hardware and selected finish.
facts.international_price_reference: US$2,299 for Navy White; optional handlebar bundle addition US$200, observed 2026-09-22. This is not a mainland delivered CNY quote.
facts.warranty: Limited lifetime structural-defect warranty for the original buyer from the official site or listed authorized dealer; invoice/receipt and online registration required. Wear, crashes and improper installation are excluded.
facts.stiffness_evidence: Firsthand review describes firmer out-of-saddle response than Winspace SLC5 with seatpost comfort retained; subjective comparison on a manufacturer-supplied review sample, without instrumented stiffness measurement.
